description: Renovate opens the dependency update pull requests of vibes. The shared preset of devops-cli sets the schedule and the groups: security fixes and patch releases come at once, other updates come each Monday with the minor updates of each ecosystem in one group, and no update waits for a minimum release age.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: vibes declares no scope/ labels and uses no scope in titles. No automerge: the ruleset of main requires no status check.

packageRules.description: pyproject.toml and the pre-commit hooks hold >= floors and no lock file. CI installs the newest release, so each update raises the floor to the version that CI tests (AGENTS.md, section 5). With the default range strategy, a >= floor admits each new release and Renovate changes nothing, also for a security fix.
A floor in the pre-commit hooks and the same floor in pyproject.toml move in one pull request. The shared preset puts the hooks in a different group.
A new Python minor waits for an approval on the Dependency Dashboard (shared preset). The Python image gets its own branch, so the other images do not wait for that approval.
The python-version inputs of the workflows name the floor of requires-python in pyproject.toml and the first entry of the CI matrix. A person changes the three together.
The ruff floor of pyproject.toml and the rev of the ruff-pre-commit hook move together, so the hook and CI run the same ruff.
A new major of an image can stop reading the config that the stack mounts.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, start the stack of `resources/docker-compose/` with the new image and check that the service loads each config file that it mounts.
